messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for streaming API (streaming.generate) across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Current p99 = 3.2s (SLO 1.5s). Error rate up ~0.8% and streaming stalls observed. Auto-mitigation attempted: routed 10% to fallback small model.

leila: seeing huge tail on streaming tail tokens, p95 ~800ms but p99 jump. paging subsystem shows large number of cache miss reactions since midnight. looks like prefix hash change rolled out ~00:15 UTC.

raj: confirmed. rollout v3-salt (commit abc1234) changed prefix hashing behavior. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 38% for high-concurrency tenants.

sofia: customer impact: AE flagged live call from acme-inc, they see long stalls and some truncated streams. AE on call now. tagging @ae-jordan for customer comms.

ae-jordan: on the bridge with acme, they're worried about degraded UX and p99 timeouts. They want ETA and mitigation.

leila: first mitigation: pause rollout and roll back prefix hashing service to v3 (pre-salt). I'm going to start rollback now.

matt: i'm on infra. rolling back routing config and stepping down workers running salted hash. will post rollback command.

matt: run: ```
kubectl set image deployment/prefix-hash prefix-hash=registry.redwood/prefix-hash:v3-20260314 --namespace=prod
kubectl rollout status deployment/prefix-hash -n prod
```

reliability-bot: Rollback triggered by matt at 5174123528. Canary traffic will be rebalanced over 5 minutes.

raj: while rollback is in flight, we can enable aggressive cache rewarm for affected tenants to reduce cold miss penalty. hitting endpoint: `/admin/cache/rewarm?tenant=acme-inc&mode=fast`

sofia: done the rewarm for top 10 tenants (acme included). rewarm commands output: ```
[rewarm] queued 12k keys for tenant acme-inc
[rewarm] background load started
```

leila: monitoring hit-rate and p99. initial numbers: cache hit-rate climbing from 38% -> 58% after rewarm for acme. p99 dropped from 3.2s -> 1.9s on their traffic but still above SLO.

matt: noticed eviction wave on edge-shards due to mismatch of salt namespace. increased shard memory by 15% to prevent further evictions. applied flag: `--edge-cache-memory-buffer=0.15`

raj: long-term: we'll need fallback hashing / dual-hash mode for overlap during rollouts. for now can enable `salt-fallback=true` in config to try old prefix map first then salted. toggling now.

matt: flag toggled at 5174123650. Confirmed fallthrough path healthy.

reliability-bot: Observability snapshot: p95=750ms, p99=1.4s, streaming stall rate reduced ~75%. No SLO breach for majority. Still monitoring for residual errors.

leila: customer update: acme reported noticeable improvement, still minor stalls for long sequences. AE will keep monitoring.

sofia: adding operational notes: impacted components = prefix-hash service, edge cache, prefetch rewarm. root cause hypothesis: v3-salt introduced new key namespace without controlled warmup; rollout ramp too fast.

leila: action items for postmortem: 1) require dual-hash compatibility and staged warmup for any prefix hash changes; 2) add canary hit-rate guard that aborts rollout if cache hit-rate drops >15% in 10m; 3) provide /admin/rewarm per-namespace and throttleable capacity; 4) playbook update for oncall to toggle `salt-fallback` and increase memory buffer.

raj: capturing logs for timeline and linking to ticket INF-2026 in ops. Also saving heap and eviction metrics from edge shards.

matt: final check: rollback completed and stable at 5174123720. traffic fully on v3 now.

leila: closing bridge in 10m if stable. handing off to night shift. handing off notes: rollback done, rewarm executed, `salt-fallback` enabled, watching p99 and eviction metrics.

tamsin: taking handoff. I'll monitor next 6h and keep AE looped for acme. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

reliability-bot: Incident summary saved to INF-2026. Recommend follow-up postmortem and sched a cross-team retro.

sofia: adding customer impact notes to ticket and drafting short post-call email to acme.

ae-jordan: acme to send formal incident note, asking for timeline and mitigation steps — I'll coordinate.

leila: good work. leaving final annotated timeline in INF-2026. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
